_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY, not applied by anything in this repository. Replace every ARN, account ID, region and image. Keys starting with underscore are not valid ECS fields: remove them before registering.
_iamNotes: Execution role: AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy plus secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on the New Relic API key secret.
Task role (read-only POC): ecs:DescribeServices, ecs:DescribeTaskDefinition on the clusters and services in scope.
Remediation is simulated/log-only in the POC, so no ecs:RegisterTaskDefinition or ecs:UpdateService is needed.
_configNotes: The image reads --config from a path. Bake a config with ecs.mode: aws and policies.dir into the image or mount it (e.g. EFS); EventBridge delivers events to port 8080 /events through an API destination or a proxy you provide.
